project.name: Avanse SEC WhatsApp AI Counsellor

task.title: Build a fully-functional POC (all BRD/PRD modules, simplified where a real dependency doesn't exist) and deploy it on Render for a management demo

next_action.description: App is deployed and live at https://sec-whatsapp-bot.onrender.com. Run the Settings page's 'Configure WhatsApp webhook' button (or POST /api/admin/whatsapp-webhook-setup) to subscribe the WABA, then have the user send a real WhatsApp message from one of the 5 verified test numbers to confirm the live channel end to end. Also decide whether to pull forward any of tech-debt D-002/D-008 before showing management.

session.last_summary: Built and deployed the full POC to Render (https://sec-whatsapp-bot.onrender.com): created the Postgres DB and web service via Render's API, pushed to a new GitHub repo, fixed two rounds of build failures (Prisma 7's config split + driver-adapter requirement, then TypeScript errors in the Gemini tool-calling code), and smoke-tested the entire golden path end to end via the web chat mirror — consent, age gate, journey fork, full profiling, RAG hook, a live-grounded Gemini answer with real current data, Tier 1 eligibility via the mock BRE, and a signed DIY handoff token with replay rejection all verified working in production. Also switched the AI orchestrator from Anthropic to Gemini per the user's instruction (ADR-006).
